detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Institutional Journal: Predictive Processing in Musical Experience
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes the current research progress regarding the predictive processing account of musical engagement. By utilizing the Action Simulation for Auditory Prediction (ASAP) hypothesis and interoceptive inference frameworks, we characterize musical experience as a dynamic calibration of temporal and emotional expectations. The current focus remains on bridging these cognitive mechanisms with structural properties of musical information.

children.title: Musical Emotion and Beat Perception as Predictive Processing

detail.title: Musical Emotion and Beat Perception as Predictive Processing
detail.summary: This notebook explores how musical engagement functions as a process of auditory prediction and interoceptive error reduction, synthesizing perspectives on beat perception and induced emotion.
detail.reason: Synthesis of the two distinct sources provides a provisional explanatory framework for musical experience consistent with project goals.
